sources.title: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (almost) Everything
sources.snippet: Native computer use offers a general interface for agents to operate almost any software available to people, but requires long-horizon state tracking, large-scale interactive experience, and learning from sparse yet verifiable outcomes.
